tool_selection.reasoning: SHAP provides a robust, game-theoretic measure of feature importance that quantifies how much each feature, including radius error, contributes to the final prediction. Sensitivity analysis directly evaluates the prediction change when a feature is removed, offering a clean operational view of the model's behavior under ablation.
